# WhichMuseum

> > WhichMuseum is a comprehensive global museum directory platform featuring 4,000+ museums across multiple countries with exhibitions, discounts, and visitor information.

WhichMuseum B.V. operates a searchable database of museums worldwide, helping travelers and culture enthusiasts discover museums, current exhibitions, and special offers. The platform includes major destinations like France (2,878+ museums), Switzerland (861+ museums), UAE (100+ museums), and Turkey (357+ museums), with free museum account registration for institutions.

## Key Topics

- Museum Directory
- Museum Exhibitions
- Museum Discounts & Passes
- Dubai Attractions (Burj Khalifa, Museum of the Future, Dubai Museum)
- Abu Dhabi Culture (Qasr Al Watan Palace, Heritage Village)
- France Museums & Paris Attractions
- Switzerland Museums & Swiss Cities
- Turkey Museums & Istanbul Landmarks
- UAE Museums & Tourism
- Museum Account Management
- Travel & Tourism Guides
- Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo
- Arte Museum Dubai
- Expo City Dubai

## Major Museum Destinations

- [France: Discover all 2878+ Museums, Exhibitions & Discounts](https://static.whichmuseum.com/place/france-11): Complete directory of 2878+ French museums including Paris attractions
- [Switzerland: Discover all 861+ Museums, Exhibitions & Discounts](https://static.whichmuseum.com/place/switzerland-10437): Comprehensive guide to 861+ Swiss museums with exhibitions & discounts
- [Turkey: Discover all 357+ Museums, Exhibitions & Discounts](https://static.whichmuseum.com/place/turkey-10440): Guide to 357+ Turkish museums featuring Istanbul landmarks & exhibitions
- [United Arab Emirates: Discover all 100+ Museums, Exhibitions & Discounts](https://static.whichmuseum.com/place/united-arab-emirates-10409): Complete directory of 100+ UAE museums including Dubai & Abu Dhabi venues

- [Museum account](https://static.whichmuseum.com/museum-account): Free museum account registration and management service
